basic_details.job_title: DGFT Ludhiana Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has released the official notification for DGFT Young Professional Recruitment 2026. A total of 3 Young Professional vacancies have been announced on a contractual basis. Candidates with a Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Commerce, or Law with a minimum of 60% marks and a maximum age of 35 years are eligible to apply. The last date to submit the application through Email is 01 August 2026. All the details related to DGFT Recruitment 2026, including vacancy details, eligibility criteria, age limit, salary, selection

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. Age as on 20 July 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DGFT Ludhiana Young Professional Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Young Professional post at DGFT Ludhiana?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Young Professional position at DGFT Ludhiana is 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Young Professional position in the DGFT Ludhiana Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Commerce, or Law from a recognized university with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional post is 35 years, as of 20 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Young Professional post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 56,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the DGFT Ludhiana Young Professional recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test or Interview, followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for this recruitment by sending their complete application via email.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), specifically DGFT Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Young Professional positions are contractual in nature.
